Header.description: Ego-Remote AMS Message Header – Standard CAV-ERA-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Ego-Remote AMS Message.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Ego-Remote AMS Message.

EgoRemoteAMSMessageID.description: Unique identifier of this Ego-Remote AMS Message instance.

EgoRemoteAMSMessageTime.description: Time this Ego-Remote AMS Message was produced.

EgoRemoteAMSMessageSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Ego-Remote AMS Message applies.

CAVIdentifier.description: Identifier of the CAV sending this message.

Message.description: One of the five message types exchanged between Ego and Remote AMS.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Ego-Remote AMS Message in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Ego-Remote AMS Message (plain text, max 2048 characters).

EgoCAVID.description: Identifier of the Ego CAV sending the request.

ULocation.description: Specification of the portion of the Remote CAV's Environment to be provided.

Trajectory.description: Trajectory the Ego CAV intends to adopt.

EgoCAVID.description: Identifier of the Ego CAV sending the alert.

AMSAlertID.description: Alert type: one of Ambulance, Authority, Health, Evacuation.

CAVState.description: Appropriate subset of the CAV State.

RoadState.description: Appropriate subset of the Road State.

RemoteCAVID.description: Identifier of the Remote CAV providing the response.

RemoteFED.description: Subset of the Remote CAV's Full Environment Descriptors relevant to the requested U-Location.

EgoCAVID.description: Identifier of the requesting Ego CAV.

AcceptReject.description: Whether the Remote AMS accepts or rejects the Ego CAV's intended Trajectory.
